name: two-point-perspective-simple
description: FEAT-D: two-point-perspective / vertical-line-lock orbit camera toggle (twoPointPerspective, pro). Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; toggling it levels the camera + applies a vertical lens-shift so pitched wall corners stop converging — before/after screenshots of the pitched 3/4 dollhouse view.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: twoPointPerspective should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: twoPointPerspective should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: menu-item-visible
steps.failMessage: Vertical lock menu item did not render in Pro mode

steps.name: probe-camera-off
steps.eval: (async()=>{const m=await import('/src/scene/pathtrace/hqRenderSource.ts'); const cam=m.getHqRenderSource().camera; window.__camProbeOff = { up: cam.up.toArray(), viewEnabled: !!(cam.view&&cam.view.enabled), fov: cam.fov, aspect: cam.aspect };})()

steps.name: probe-camera-on
steps.eval: (async()=>{const m=await import('/src/scene/pathtrace/hqRenderSource.ts'); const cam=m.getHqRenderSource().camera; window.__camProbeOn = { up: cam.up.toArray(), viewEnabled: !!(cam.view&&cam.view.enabled), offsetY: cam.view&&cam.view.offsetY, fov: cam.fov, aspect: cam.aspect };})()

steps.name: assert-camera-math

waitFor.store: (() => { const off = window.__camProbeOff; const on = window.__camProbeOn; return off && on && off.viewEnabled === false && on.viewEnabled === true && on.up[0] === 0 && on.up[1] === 1 && on.up[2] === 0 && Math.abs(on.aspect - off.aspect) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(on.fov - off.fov) < 1e-6; })()

steps.failMessage: vertical-lock should enable a camera.view offset without touching fov/aspect

steps.name: assert-clean-fallback
steps.failMessage: turning the toggle back off should clear the view offset (clean fallback to normal perspective)

steps.name: mobile-item-visible
steps.failMessage: Vertical lock did not render in the mobile View section
